summary.text: Amy Klobuchar is Minnesota's senior U.S. Senator, first elected in 2006, and the DFL nominee for governor with running mate Ben Schierer, former mayor of Fergus Falls. She previously served as Hennepin County Attorney.

paragraphs.text: Born in Plymouth, Minnesota; B.A. in political science from Yale University (1982) and J.D. from the University of Chicago Law School (1985).
Worked as a corporate lawyer and partner at Minnesota law firms before entering public office.
Served as Hennepin County Attorney, then was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2006 and has served since 2007.
